### KVL-001 · Kestrel Valley

`level.kvl.kestrel_valley` · **Type** Open Region · **Act** I (open from 0:30) + Earth Returns · **Missions** M1.01–M1.07, Earth Returns side content · **Size** 8,000 m × 8,000 m × 700 m (64 km²) · **Playtime** 2.5 h story, 10+ h exploration

**On planet:** Earth (starter planet) (PLN-001) at 38.2°, -116.3°

> A 64 km² hand-authored open region of Nevada high desert ringed by mountains: the spaceport, its company town and nine other districts. The whole valley is open from the end of the prologue; danger (Bloom threat), not walls, gates the districts.

**Player goals**

- Find survivors, parts and a base site
- Complete the four Wren parts in any order
- Explore districts for blueprints, caches and stories

**Spaces**

| Space | Size (W × D × H) | Purpose | Position (x, y, z) |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Valley floor** | 6000 m × 6000 m × 50 m | High-desert basin, dry washes, sagebrush | 0 m, 0 m, 0 m |
| **Mountain rim** | 8000 m × 8000 m × 700 m | Impassable ring (visual boundary); flyable over from Act II | 0 m, 0 m, 0 m |
| **Route 93** | 8 m × 8000 m × 0 m | North–south highway along x = −2 km, with spurs to the Township and Complex | -2000 m, 0 m, 0 m |

**Connections:** Route 93 ↔ Kestrel Township (road); Route 93 ↔ Prospect (road); Kestrel Township ↔ Kestrel Aerospace Complex (road); Hollis Dam ↔ Silver Ridge Mines (dirt track); Fort Calder ↔ Red Mesa Observatory (dirt track)

**Encounters:** Roaming hordes at night (Attraction-driven); Runner packs on open ground; Coyote packs; Directorate drone patrols near crash sites

**Landmarks & navigation:** Launch tower at Pad 39-K (110 m, visible from anywhere); Hollis Dam wall (north); Red Mesa radio dishes (southeast); Prospect's burning skyline (west)

**Environment:** gravity 1 g; atmosphere Breathable; hazards: Heat waves, dust storms, flash floods, spore storms from Prospect; Bloom ●○○○○ to ●●●●● by district; building: Allowed (except within 150 m of story anchors)

**Mood & lighting:** 60-min day/night cycle; missions set their own time. Hard desert sun by day; sodium floodlights and fires by night. Palette: Desert sand `#C9A66B` · Sage `#8A9A6B` · Sky blue `#7FB2D9` · Sodium night `#E8A13A`

**Audio:** Wind, insects by day, distant moans and coyotes by night; the Verdance clicks rise near Prospect.

**Open-world links:** Leads to orbit via the Wren (M1.07); re-entry from Act II anywhere on Earth.

**Blender spec**

- **File:** `assets/levels/kestrel-valley/LVL_KVL_001_KestrelValley.blend` → `export/levels/kestrel-valley/LVL_KVL_001_KestrelValley.fbx` + `.markers.json`
- **Streaming:** 1,024 cells of 256 m (loading range 768 m) · per cell: blockout ≤ 50,000 tris, memory ≤ 60 MB, ≤ 400 draw calls, ≤ 4 shadow-casting lights
